_comment: Factory settings for every agent: the values that ship with the package. A course override or a user override wins over anything here (see aied_db/agent_config.py). Seeded into agent_config_defaults by scripts/init_db.py, which holds the admin role; no other role may write that collection. Keys beginning with _ are comments.

agents._comment: Factory settings for the Assessment Agent. The three grading weights MUST sum to 1.0 (checked by AgentConfig.check_weights). manual_weight 0.1 is the 10% manual review reserved in curriculum-designer's rubric; whether review REPLACES or ADJUSTS the AI score is still an open question for the team.

settings.description: config.DEFAULT_MODEL. Must be one of llm/models.SUPPORTED_MODELS.
Weight of code criteria. The three weights must sum to 1.0.
Weight of report criteria. The three weights must sum to 1.0.
Weight reserved for instructor review. The three weights must sum to 1.0.
Whether a low-confidence grade is set to needs_review automatically.

agents._comment: Factory settings for the Curriculum Designer. Enumerations mirror curriculum-designer@93ec2c0 services/schema.py.

settings.description: How closely a generated lab sticks to the uploaded material.
Default difficulty tier for generated quiz questions.
Default estimated lab duration in minutes.
A generated lab needs instructor approval before students see it. An agent can never approve its own lab, so this is admin-only.

agents._comment: Factory settings for the Guardian (integrity) agent. Values taken from ui-student@6f71458: the escalation threshold is the `violation_count >= 3` in agents/guardian.py, the guidance levels are GUIDANCE_INSTRUCTIONS in agents/lab_companion.py. READ-ONLY: edit this file in git, then re-seed. Instructors override per course in agent_configs.

settings.description: Violations in one session before it is escalated for review.
Whether reaching the threshold escalates automatically, or only flags.
Guidance level a session starts at before any violation.
SystemConfig.verifier_max_retries: retries before the safe fallback.

agents._comment: Factory settings for the Integrity agent. Thresholds are placeholders agreed with nobody yet: the task3 integrity draft does not specify them. Confirm with Rocio's team before relying on these numbers.

settings.description: Minimum confidence before an evaluation becomes a violation.
Violations by one student before escalation.
Risk level assumed when no issues were detected.

agents._comment: Factory settings for the Lab Companion. Values taken from ui-student@6f71458 SystemConfig's tutoring knobs and kb/base.format_context.

settings.description: SystemConfig.rag_top_n: chunks retrieved per question.
SystemConfig.rag_max_content_chars: per-chunk truncation in the prompt.
Must stay 1536-dimensional to match the rag_vectors index.
SystemConfig.history_keep_turns: turns of history sent to the model.

agents._comment: Factory settings for the Participant agent, which logs interaction telemetry and derives a student's hint profile.

settings.description: Most recent interactions considered when building student context.
Hint level assumed for a student with no history yet.
